items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: I was playing with Pierron on band number two with Hippolyte Charles.

ctx.x: He was with Pierron on trombone for years. Tell him he was with Pierron.

He used to be with Pierron on trombone a long time. Johnny Lindsey. Yeah. And he was this bright fella? Yeah, this slender tall brown skin fella. Yeah. He went to Chicago. Oh, yeah. Well, maybe he was playing with Romeo with Pierron, but I was playing with Pierron on band number two with Hippolyte Charles. You got him, ain't ya? Mm-hmm. Yeah. I was playing with him. But the doctor stopped Hippolyte Charles from playing on a guy that had bad hearts and
the, uh, let's see, who else would be with Robeshoe?

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: I used to play with Hippolyte Charles.

ctx.x: Yeah, I heard talk about him.

Oh, yeah. He used to play with people. And then he played with us. And then he played with George Williams, big George Williams. Then he had a band, you know. Boy, he played with Peerrell until Peerrell died. Then after that, he didn't spend with anybody, you know. Work all the time. He was a printer, you know. Played music at night. He was a heavy drinker. He was the finest man in one of me. He didn't look at him up there. I used to play with him sometimes too. Me and him and Eddie Hickman. Three piece. He could…
